modules.title: Functional Transitions
modules.desc: Pure functional state transitions, execution folds, and parallel execution.

symbols.name: init

symbols.name: tell
symbols.doc: Pure transition `(state, x, y) -> (next_state, fitted_mu)` leaving `state` untouched.

symbols.sig: (state: 'OptimizerState', objective: 'Callable[[Any], Any]', *, num_arms: 'int' = 1, use_pytree: 'bool' = False) -> 'tuple[OptimizerState, np.ndarray]'

symbols.sig: (state: 'OptimizerState', key: 'Any' = None, steps: 'int' = 0, eval_fn: 'Callable[..., Any] | None' = None, num_arms: 'int' = 1) -> 'Any'
symbols.doc: Fold `steps` pure optimization rounds over `state` and `key`, returning `(final_state, next_key, traces)`.

symbols.name: pmap
symbols.sig: (state: 'OptimizerState', key: 'Any', branches: 'int', branch_fn: 'Callable[[int, OptimizerState, Any], Any]') -> 'list[Any]'
symbols.doc: Fork `state` and split `key` across `branches`, executing `branch_fn` in parallel across threads.

symbols.name: complete

symbols.name: cancel
symbols.doc: Pure transition retiring unevaluated IDs without recording a reward.

symbols.name: digest
symbols.doc: Return the 64-character lowercase hexadecimal BLAKE3 digest of `state`.

symbols.name: freeze
symbols.doc: Serialize `state` into a portable binary checkpoint.

symbols.name: thaw
symbols.doc: Restore an `OptimizerState` from a binary checkpoint without mutating `state`.

symbols.name: OptimizerState
symbols.sig: (dim: 'int', bounds: 'np.ndarray', config: 'OptimizerConfig', seed: 'int', epoch: 'int', spec: 'PyTreeSpec | None', identified: 'bool', num_observations: 'int', num_regions: 'int', tr_length: 'float', init_progress: 'tuple[int, int] | None', pending_ids: 'tuple[int, ...] | None', ingestion_failure: 'str | None', telemetry: 'Telemetry', _log: 'tuple[_Op, ...]', _cursor: '_Cursor') -> None

symbols.name: AskBatch
symbols.sig: (ids: 'tuple[AskId, ...]', points: 'np.ndarray', spec: 'Any' = None, weights: 'np.ndarray | None' = None) -> None
symbols.doc: Coordinates, evaluation identities, and structured PyTree views from one ask.

symbols.name: AskId
symbols.doc:
Opaque, process-wide identity for one regional evaluation.

The optimizer checks this token against the proposal's stored generation
provenance when completing or cancelling it. Pass it back unchanged.

symbols.name: split

symbols.name: fold
symbols.doc: Deterministically fold an integer `tag` into `k`.

symbols.name: Key
symbols.doc: Splittable 128-bit cryptographic PRNG key for functional pipelines.

symbols.name: stein
symbols.sig: (target: 'Any' = None, frame: 'Any' = None, *, rank: 'int | None' = None) -> 'Any'
symbols.doc:
Applies Stiefel subspace James-Stein contraction to a state, config, or Transform.

Args:
    target: Target state/config/Transform, or a Stiefel frame / integer rank
        when constructing a pipeline Transform.
    frame: Optional Stiefel frame or integer rank when target is a state or config.
    rank: Optional principal Stiefel subspace rank for online estimation.

Returns:
    Updated state/config or composable Transform.

symbols.doc:
Applies an Affine posterior location-scale map to a state, config, or Transform.

Args:
    target: Target state/config/Transform, or an Affine map / conformal alpha
        when constructing a pipeline Transform.
    affine: Optional Affine map or conformal alpha when target is a state or config.
    alpha: Optional conformal miscoverage rate in (0, 1) for online calibration.

Returns:
    Updated state/config or composable Transform.

modules.title: Domain Charts & PyTree
modules.desc: Structured parameter manifolds, section–retraction charts, and tree flattening.

symbols.name: pytree_bounds
symbols.doc: Construct a `PyTreeSpec` (`Space`) from a template PyTree of arrays, shapes, or manifold embeddings.

symbols.name: Log
symbols.doc: Scale-invariant multiplicative Riemannian embedding on [low, high] subset R_+ (Čencov, 1982).

symbols.name: Periodic
symbols.doc: Isometric S^1 circle embedding mapping theta in [low, high) to 2 tied coordinates in [0, 1]^2.

symbols.name: Simplex
symbols.doc: Fisher-Rao Hellinger square-root embedding psi_i(p) = sqrt(p_i) on Delta^{d-1} (Bhattacharyya, 1943; Čencov, 1982).

symbols.name: categorical
symbols.sig: (categories: 'Sequence[Any]', *, encoding: 'str' = 'auto', key: 'Any' = None, seed: 'Any' = None, separation: 'float' = 10.0, dim_cap: 'int' = 48) -> 'Categorical'
symbols.doc: Construct an isometric `Categorical` leaf specification.

symbols.name: Categorical
symbols.sig: (categories: 'tuple[Any, ...]', encoding: 'str' = 'auto', seed: 'Any' = None, separation: 'float' = 10.0, dim_cap: 'int' = 48, key: 'Any' = None) -> None
symbols.doc: Isometric one-hot or Rademacher JL specification (Johnson & Lindenstrauss, 1984; Achlioptas, 2003).

symbols.name: Stiefel
symbols.doc: Orthonormal subspace frame `(M, F)` on the Stiefel manifold `V_F(R^M)` for James-Stein contraction (Stein, 1956; James & Stein, 1961; Efron & Morris, 1973; Higham, 1986).

symbols.name: Affine
symbols.doc: Affine location-scale posterior map `(a + b*mu, c*se) in Aff(1)^M` (Aitken, 1935; Vovk et al., 2005; Lei et al., 2018).

symbols.name: ravel
symbols.doc: Flatten a single PyTree into `(dim,)` or a stacked/sequence batch into `(n, dim)`.

symbols.name: unflatten
symbols.doc: Reconstruct a single parameter PyTree from a 1D flat vector of length `spec.dim`.

symbols.name: unflatten_batch
symbols.doc: Reconstruct a tuple of `n` parameter PyTrees from a 2D `(n, spec.dim)` batch matrix.

symbols.name: unflatten_stacked
symbols.doc: Reconstruct a single PyTree whose leaves have leading batch axis `(n, *leaf_shape)`.

symbols.name: PyTreeSpec
symbols.sig: (dim: 'Any', bounds: 'Any' = None, leaves: 'Any' = None, template: 'Any' = None, *, low: 'Any' = -1.0, high: 'Any' = 1.0) -> 'None'
symbols.doc: Immutable structural specification, manifold embeddings, and bounds for a parameter PyTree.

symbols.name: LeafSpec

modules.title: Hardware & Adapters
modules.desc: Device capability enumeration, stateful wrappers, and Optuna integration.

symbols.name: capabilities
symbols.doc:
Inspect the installed extension; optionally exercise native runtimes.

Runtime probes can initialize drivers and compile kernels. Python framework
installation or GPU detection never substitutes for native build support.
``posterior`` describes the original host-array interface.
``device_posterior`` describes FP32 device queries and DLPack moments/draws
for explicit CUDA/Metal indices, scale_x=False, and unbounded outputs.

symbols.name: create_optimizer
symbols.doc: Build an optimizer from the Python config.

symbols.name: Optimizer
symbols.doc:
Optimize a bounded search space through Rust-owned ask/tell state.

``ask`` returns parameter rows for objective evaluation. ``tell`` records
objective values and optional observation variances. Objective evaluation
belongs to the caller; constructing this object does not select a Python
array framework or imply that posterior computation runs on an accelerator.

symbols.name: turbo_enn
symbols.sig: (*, enn: 'ENNSurrogate | None' = None, trust_region: 'TrustRegionConfig | None' = None, candidates: 'CandidateConfig | None' = None, num_init: 'int | None' = None, acquisition: 'AcquisitionKind' = <AcquisitionKind.PARETO: 'pareto'>) -> 'OptimizerConfig'
symbols.doc: Build a TuRBO configuration backed by an Epistemic Nearest Neighbors surrogate.

symbols.name: turbo_one
symbols.sig: (*, num_candidates: 'int | None' = None, num_init: 'int | None' = None, trust_region: 'TrustRegionConfig | None' = None, sampler: 'CandidateSampler' = <CandidateSampler.SOBOL: 'sobol'>, acquisition: 'AcquisitionKind' = <AcquisitionKind.THOMPSON: 'thompson'>) -> 'OptimizerConfig'
symbols.doc: Build a TuRBO-1 configuration backed by a Gaussian process surrogate.

symbols.name: turbo_zero
symbols.sig: (*, num_candidates: 'int | None' = None, num_candidates_per_arm: 'int | None' = None, num_init: 'int | None' = None, trust_region: 'TrustRegionConfig | None' = None, sampler: 'CandidateSampler' = <CandidateSampler.SOBOL: 'sobol'>) -> 'OptimizerConfig'
symbols.doc: Build a surrogate-free TuRBO-0 configuration using random acquisition.

symbols.name: lhd_only
symbols.sig: (*, num_candidates: 'int | None' = None, num_init: 'int | None' = None, trust_region: 'TrustRegionConfig | None' = None, sampler: 'CandidateSampler' = <CandidateSampler.SOBOL: 'sobol'>) -> 'OptimizerConfig'
symbols.doc: Build a Latin hypercube design-only optimizer configuration.

symbols.name: BackendCapabilities
symbols.sig: (name: 'BackendName', compiled: 'bool', available: 'bool | None', reason: 'str | None', direct_operations: 'tuple[str, ...]', fallback_operations: 'tuple[str, ...]', missing_operations: 'tuple[str, ...]', host_operations: 'tuple[str, ...]', array_frameworks: 'tuple[str, ...]') -> None
symbols.doc:
Native build support, runtime availability, and transfer requirements.

``available=None`` means compiled but not probed. ``direct_operations``
describes where arithmetic executes, not memory residency. Operations in
``host_operations`` accept/return host arrays. ``array_frameworks`` lists
installed Python packages only; it does not establish native support.
A successful runtime probe exercises neighbor search, not every operation.

symbols.name: Telemetry
symbols.doc: Timing and candidate-count telemetry from an optimizer proposal step.

symbols.name: TellPredictionError
symbols.doc:
Native ingestion succeeded, but retrieving the fitted mean failed.

Retry ``optimizer.posterior_mu(x)``, not ``optimizer.tell(x, y)``.
This does not classify failures raised by native ingestion itself.
